title: Native mailbox wake leaves an on-request Codex session held on 'Codex needs MCP input' with no one to answer
outcome: It is established what a Codex session with approvalPolicy on-request asks for when woken by native mail, and such a session can handle its mail, or the host says clearly that it can't, instead of sitting silently held.
acceptance: The exact pending request of a held session is established from source or a supported read, and the host surfaces enough of it for an operator or agent to see what is being asked.

Whether an on-request Codex session can handle native mail without a person is stated with evidence; if it can't, sending or listing shows that limit, or a fix lands with a behaviour test, a review pair with no Medium or higher, and the normal gate. No approval is clicked on anyone's behalf, and no policy is changed silently.
